metas.name: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
metas.description: Directed by Shane Black, it shares the same witty dialogue, buddy-cop dynamic, and sharp crime-comedy energy as 'The Nice Guys'.

metas.name: Stardust
metas.description: An enchanting fantasy adventure with a lighthearted tone and magical elements that will appeal to fans of 'Practical Magic' and 'Fantastic Beasts'.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: Features the same irreverent humor, vibrant colors, and high-stakes action comedy found in 'Thor: Ragnarok'.

metas.name: The Princess Bride
metas.description: A classic fantasy adventure that blends romance, comedy, and fun action in a way that aligns with your love for 'Dungeons & Dragons'.

metas.name: Free Guy
metas.description: A high-energy adventure about being inside a game world, mirroring the fun and meta-humor of the modern 'Jumanji' films.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: A perfect blend of adventure, comedy, and supernatural elements that captures the 'D&D' and 'Fantastic Beasts' spirit.

metas.name: Knives Out
metas.description: A fun, stylish mystery with a comedic edge, perfect for someone who enjoyed the crime-comedy vibes of 'Get Shorty'.

metas.name: Palm Springs
metas.description: A clever and hilarious romantic comedy with a sci-fi twist that matches the whimsical nature of 'Night Is Short, Walk On Girl'.

metas.name: Shazam!
metas.description: A lighthearted superhero movie that prioritizes humor and heart over grit, similar to 'Thor: Ragnarok'.

metas.name: Kingsman: The Secret Service
metas.description: Offers high-octane fun and stylized action choreography for those who liked 'Pacific Rim: Uprising'.

metas.name: The Mask
metas.description: Stars Jim Carrey in another iconic, high-energy comedic role that fans of 'Ace Ventura' will adore.

metas.name: Galaxy Quest
metas.description: A brilliant parody of sci-fi tropes that provides the same self-aware fun as 'Thor: Ragnarok'.

metas.name: Bullet Train
metas.description: An action-packed comedy with quirky characters and fast-paced dialogue, matching the tone of 'The Nice Guys'.

metas.name: Spy
metas.description: A hilarious take on the espionage genre that provides the physical comedy seen in 'Brüno' and 'Ace Ventura'.

metas.name: Game Night
metas.description: A modern comedy classic with great chemistry between leads, satisfying fans of both 'The Nice Guys' and 'Jumanji'.

metas.name: A Knight's Tale
metas.description: An anachronistic, fun-filled adventure that blends medieval fantasy with a modern comedic sensibility.

metas.name: The Grand Budapest Hotel
metas.description: A visually stunning and whimsical caper that aligns with the artistic and quirky energy of 'Night Is Short, Walk On Girl'.

metas.name: Hot Fuzz
metas.description: A masterclass in action-comedy that subverts genre tropes, appealing to fans of 'The Nice Guys' and 'Thor: Ragnarok'.

metas.name: The Lost City
metas.description: A light jungle adventure with romantic comedy elements, very much in the vein of the recent 'Jumanji' movies.

metas.name: Popstar: Never Stop Never Stopping
metas.description: A hilarious mockumentary that captures the same 'cringe-comedy' and absurdist satire found in 'Brüno'.

metas.name: Everything Everywhere All At Once
metas.description: A wild, creative, and comedic journey across the multiverse that matches the high-energy fantasy of 'Thor' and 'D&D'.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: The ultimate comfort movie; it is heartwarming, funny, and beautifully crafted for relaxation.

metas.name: Coming to America
metas.description: A legendary comedy with excellent character work, matching the broad and funny appeal of 'Ace Ventura'.

metas.name: Snatch
metas.description: A fast-paced, stylish crime comedy with a large cast of characters, perfect for fans of 'Get Shorty'.

metas.name: Puss in Boots: The Last Wish
metas.description: A visually spectacular adventure that balances humor and high-stakes fantasy similar to 'D&D: Honor Among Thieves'.

metas.name: Enchanted
metas.description: A playful take on fairy tales that combines fantasy, romance, and comedy like 'Practical Magic'.

metas.name: Big Trouble in Little China
metas.description: A cult classic fantasy action-comedy that doesn't take itself too seriously, much like 'Anaconda' or 'D&D'.

metas.name: Zombieland
metas.description: Combines action, comedy, and light horror elements in a fun, fast-paced road trip format.

metas.name: Logan Lucky
metas.description: A charming and funny heist movie with a great ensemble cast, echoing the vibe of 'Get Shorty'.

metas.name: About Time
metas.description: A heartwarming romantic comedy with a supernatural time-travel twist, perfect for a cozy night in.

metas.name: The Fifth Element
metas.description: A vibrant, stylish, and campy sci-fi adventure that matches the colorful fun of 'Thor: Ragnarok'.

metas.name: 21 Jump Street
metas.description: An incredibly funny action-comedy reboot that relies on the chemistry between its leads, like 'The Nice Guys'.

metas.name: Amélie
metas.description: A whimsical, feel-good French film with a unique visual style similar to 'Night Is Short, Walk On Girl'.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A fast-paced, hilarious animated adventure that the whole family can enjoy, full of creative energy.

metas.name: Kick-Ass
metas.description: A fun and irreverent take on the superhero genre for those who enjoy the edge of 'Thor: Ragnarok'.

metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: A classic, highly quotable comedy that is perfect for a lighthearted and nostalgic viewing experience.

metas.name: School of Rock
metas.description: An uplifting and genuinely funny movie about the power of music and being yourself.

metas.name: O Brother, Where Art Thou?
metas.description: A quirky, musical, and comedic adventure that fits the oddball crime-comedy category of 'Get Shorty'.

metas.name: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
metas.description: A high-quality romantic comedy with multiple intersecting storylines and great performances.

metas.name: Men in Black
metas.description: A perfect blend of sci-fi, action, and buddy-comedy that feels right at home with 'Fantastic Beasts' and 'Jumanji'.
